name: Freycinet Adventures
summary: Guided sea kayak tours in double kayaks around Coles Bay and Freycinet National Park, with all gear and warm jackets supplied. Choices include a 3 hour paddle below the Hazards, a sunrise paddle with breakfast at Honeymoon Bay, an oyster tasting paddle in Moulting Lagoon, and a guided walk to the Wineglass Bay Lookout. Beginners are welcome, and children can join most paddles from age 7.
standouts: Kayak tours run year round from Coles Bay
Double sea kayaks, warm jackets and dry bags provided
Listed #4 must-do experience in Australia on the Nine Network's Things to Try Before you Die (as stated on the site)

trips.title: The Freycinet Paddle
trips.summary: A 3 hour guided sea kayak tour along the Freycinet coastline, below the pink granite Hazards and over clear water. Halfway through, the group stops on a quiet beach for fresh coffee and a snack. Morning and twilight sessions follow the same route, and the twilight one finishes at sunset.
highlights: Paddle under the Hazards in Freycinet National Park
Beach stop for freshly brewed coffee and a snack
Morning or twilight session, same route
trips.season: Year round, with seasonal departure times
trips.departsFrom: Muirs Beach, Coles Bay (free public parking and toilets)

trips.title: Sunrise Breakfast Paddle
trips.summary: A 2.5 hour guided paddle at sunrise, when the water around Coles Bay is often at its calmest. The group stops at Honeymoon Bay for a continental breakfast with coffee or tea. Stingrays and sea eagles are common, and dolphins, whales or fur seals are seen on occasion.
highlights: Continental breakfast and coffee or tea at Honeymoon Bay
Often the calmest water of the day
Wildlife such as stingrays and white-bellied sea eagles

trips.title: Oyster Tasting Paddle
trips.summary: A 3 hour paddle down the Swan River estuary in the Moulting Lagoon wetland, past oyster farms and plenty of birdlife. The guide explains how the oysters are grown and harvested, then the group lands at MelShell Oyster Shack to taste half a dozen. It covers about 6km of paddling, so a moderate level of fitness is needed.
highlights: Half a dozen oysters and a soft drink at MelShell Oyster Shack
Paddle through the Moulting Lagoon wetland and bird sanctuary
Pass working oyster farms with the guide
trips.season: Monday to Friday over the summer time
trips.departsFrom: Point Meredith (about 15 minutes' drive from Coles Bay)
trips.requirements: Children aged 12 years and over; under 16s must be with an accompanying adult. No experience needed; moderate fitness required (about 2 hours of paddling).

trips.title: Wineglass Bay walking tour
trips.summary: A guided walk of about 3km return to the Wineglass Bay Lookout with a local guide. The guide covers the park's history, geology and Aboriginal and cultural heritage. Return transfers from Freycinet Lodge and a light snack are included.
highlights: Local guide on history, geology and Aboriginal heritage
Return transfer from Freycinet Lodge to the Wineglass Bay carpark
